[u][b][color=#6d9eeb][size=6]Introduction:[/size][/color][/b][/u]

If you see any issues please let me know and I will be very eager to fix them because that will help me learn![/size][/font]


[u][b][color=#6d9eeb][size=6]Description:[/size][/color][/b][/u]
[size=2][font=Arial]Replaces the sprite (Character Model) as well as the portrait for the dwarf with a skimpily clad busty female dwarf![/font][font=Arial]

Using [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], the character sprite and the portrait are replaced with my edited versions.

[/font][/size][u][b][color=#6d9eeb][size=6]Compatibility Notes:[/size][/color][/b][/u][i]
[font=Arial][size=2]-No mod [b]conflicts[/b] that I know of yet.
[/size][/font][/i][i][font=Arial][size=2][b]
-Issues [/b]may arise if you have any other mods installed that edit the same files. [/size][/font]

[/i]
[u][b][color=#6d9eeb][size=6]SMAPI/Content Patcher Installation:[/size][/color][/b]
[/u][font=Arial][size=2]Admittedly I have not yet tried it with a mod loader because I typically do things manually but it should work fine.[/size]

[b][color=#6d9eeb]1)[/color][/b][size=2] Install and/or update Stardew Valley.[/size]

[b][color=#6d9eeb]2)[/color][/b][size=2] Download and/or update [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url][size=2].[/size]

[b][color=#6d9eeb]3)[/color][/b][size=2] Download and/or update [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][size=2].﻿[/size]

[b][color=#6d9eeb]4)[/color][/b][size=2] Download this mod, then extract it.[/size]

[b][color=#6d9eeb]5)[/color][/b][size=2] Move the extracted folder (which contains the assets folder, content.json, & manifest.json) into your "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder so that the final file structure looks like this: "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] NoFogBob's Dwarf - Skimpy Redux\assets"[/size]

[b][color=#6d9eeb]6)[/color][/b][size=2] That's it you're done, enjoy! (Ask in comments or PM me if you have any issues...)[/size][i]

[/i]
[u][b][color=#6d9eeb][size=6]Manual Installation:[/size][/color][/b]
[/u][font=Arial][size=2]Manual version in optional files

[color=#6d9eeb][b]1)[/b] [/color]Install and/or update Stardew Valley.

[b][color=#6d9eeb]2)[/color][/b] Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

[b][color=#6d9eeb]3)[/color][/b] Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].﻿

[color=#6d9eeb][b]4)[/b] [/color]Download this mod, then extract it.

[b][color=#6d9eeb]5)[/color][/b] Move the extracted folder (which contains the Character & Portraits folders) into your main "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley" folder so that the final file structure looks like this: "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Characters" as well as "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits" and allow it to overwrite.

[b][color=#6d9eeb]6)[/color][/b] That's it you're done, enjoy! (Ask in comments or PM me if you have any issues...)

[/size][/font][/font]
